notes.title: YVY's gameplay: what is an active auto-battler?
notes.notes:
Hello players, in today's news, let's focus on YVY's gameplay. A game with dice, you say? Absolutely! We call YVY an active auto-battler, where the main mechanic and combat revolve around dice! Let's answer a few of your questions:

[h3]Why did you choose to go for a strategy game to tell YVY's story?[/h3]
It was a very organic process. The idea for the gameplay and dice-based combat came before the theme and story. As we developed these mechanics, we also built the world around them. We knew we wanted to tell a story about a character overcoming overwhelming odds, which led us to the theme of resistance. Naturally, we found inspiration in the history of our own country.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/48c50ac5e27a7b1de14f38e67bdfa01c1355e14a.jpg[/img]

[h3]What is an "active" auto-battler combat?[/h3]
It’s a mix of automatic combat with a touch of player interaction. In essence, YVY’s characters fight each other automatically, but to make the experience more engaging, players have access to limited-use skills that can be strategically activated to influence the outcome of the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/aeb94f6623d74f1889f5ee1fb9e704aa71f5ba1a.gif[/img]

[h3]Why did you decide to go for a dice mechanic?[/h3]
We love dice-based games, especially board games and RPGs. So, we decided we wanted to create a game where dice crafting was at the core of the gameplay. We experimented with several different approaches in our prototypes, but the idea that "your die is your character" ended up being our favorite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/9220b17186bf0631c849370b5ba75785c76da4af.png[/img]

[h3]Why only one dice during combat and not more?[/h3]
The biggest reason for using only one die is that the game takes place in real-time rather than in turns. We experimented with versions that used multiple dice and even versions where enemies also rolled dice, but this made the game too chaotic and hard to follow due to multiple dice rolling on the screen at the same time. By focusing on a single six-sided die that is rolled multiple times per battle, we found an interesting balance between luck and strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/c2d784c589722b8a1fb5edb4d661da80d6ebe6c3.jpg[/img]

[h3]What are the different opportunities to customize the dice?[/h3]
You can choose from many different abilities for each of the six faces of the die, creating countless possibilities. Each face can also be upgraded to become stronger. Additionally, enchantments can be attached to each face, granting extra effects. Beyond dice customization, players can build their character using items, talents, artifacts, potions, and active skills known as Battle Drums.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/f60661ec61645127916b7c7e591d315b4f779ede.png[/img]

[h3]Will there be other animal spirits to fight with?[/h3]
Yes! We have three playable characters planned for the game’s launch, each with different specializations and exclusive dice faces. While the characters follow certain archetypes, such as Tugã, who is a classic tank with access to stronger defensive abilities, the complete customization of their abilities through dice faces allows for multiple playstyles for each character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/22546a25959f912209bb185b9ad1451452c45f6f.png[/img]

Let us know if you have any questions about the gameplay, we'd be more than happy to answer. Come chat on Discord!

notes.title: What is YVY?
notes.notes:
Hello players!

We've decided to share our first Steam News for the event, Games Made in Brazil! And what better than explaining what YVY is?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/4b3350779f451350944611f7018669626c4f112e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/c620204491ec3d9b3c1f57f314d7696dc8c2c003.png[/img]
[h2]What is YVY?[/h2]
YVY is a rogue-lite, fast-paced dice battler game set in a world inspired by historical events of 16th-century Brazil. Use the power of divinity, build your own dice by strategically choosing each face, and defend your homeland against the threat of colonial invasion!

[h3]A Great Entry Point to Dice-Building Games [/h3]
YVY offers a welcoming introduction to the genre with a single die to manage and an auto-battler system that still grants players agency through active skills. At the same time, seasoned players will find plenty of tough challenges that push their strategy and decision-making to the limit. The game remains simple to newcomers as it relies on a single die to customize but offers a lot of replayability with a variety of builds (die faces, skill, artifacts, equipment) for more advanced players

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/f60661ec61645127916b7c7e591d315b4f779ede.png[/img]
[h3]An active auto-battler and Fast-paced combat[/h3]
Engage in real-time automatic battles where customizable dice rolls shape the flow of combat. Use active skills to influence outcomes, striking a balance between strategy, chance, and player control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/50f36a487a92cd672bb92102b5b874a4bef5b578.png[/img]
[h3]Defend Your Land Through a Unique Perspective with its Brazilian Indigenous Theme[/h3]
Immersed in 16th-century Brazil and its diverse indigenous cultures, the world of YVY offers a unique layer of fantasy, providing an authentic and engaging experience.

Explore the struggle of indigenous peoples against colonial invaders, highlighting a perspective rarely seen, and introducing customs, experiences, and characters of the Earth's Hand people, providing an exciting and immersive narrative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/6bc41a5c39eff771c55002b54351bcea3f9a806e.png[/img]
[h3]Diverse and Beautiful Art & Sound[/h3]
Immerse yourself in YVY’s vibrant visuals, inspired by Brazil's rich natural landscapes and indigenous art. Coupled with an original soundtrack that incorporates traditional Brazilian elements, the game offers a world that feels alive, refreshing, and distinctly unique.
Who is behind the Art and sound? XX

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/af8bee9fc3200131feb104106f575126ae64f8a5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/19b9410329f58df70b9d6cd65d98afcdda9dec36.png[/img]
[h3]How far is the game in development?[/h3]
We are in the beta stage. Most of the content and mechanics have already been developed, and we have conducted several initial tests with small groups. Now, it’s time to showcase YVY to a larger audience and test it with even more players. We know there’s still a long road ahead and plenty to improve, but we’re very excited to receive feedback from players who will experience our new battles and meet the new characters!

[h3]Who is behind the Art and sound?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Music: Nelson D.
[*] Art: Valves, Júlia Chiarelli, Andê Borges
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/c620204491ec3d9b3c1f57f314d7696dc8c2c003.png[/img]
[h3]Some games that inspired us[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Loop Hero[/b]: A pretty cool autobattler where you focus on only one character at a time. It was the main inspiration for our combat. We also decided that telling a story in chapters would work really well for YVY!
[*] [b]Slay The Spire[/b]: The main reference for the roguelike progression structure, featuring maps composed of various nodes, events, shops, battles, and more.
[*] [b]Dicey Dungeons[/b]: Combat with dice can be really fun, and Dicey Dungeons is one of the best examples of that.
[*] [b]Pokémon Quest[/b]: An auto battler game where the player can use real-time abilities. Used as inspiration for the Battle Drums.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/97fa24cda6b96d2eda240ce38b5edf56e0c21dd7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045644/19b9410329f58df70b9d6cd65d98afcdda9dec36.png[/img]
